verdict.rationale: Jeeves' API platform (jeeves-docs-7) exposes endpoints for a company's own cards, payments, and expense data — it is aimed at businesses managing their own spend, not at developers embedding branded banking accounts into their own end-customer products. There is no mention of white-labeling, sponsor-bank passthrough, or multi-tenant account issuance that would let a developer offer banking to their own customers without a license.
